title: "Dashboard"
description: "Access and methodology for separately hosted workforce reports."

## Availability

No public report is connected to this v0.1 site yet. The Power BI report will remain hosted separately; this page will provide its access link and context.

## What will accompany a report

- Report title, scope, and intended questions.
- Observation period and latest successful data refresh, distinct from the page update date.
- Sources, metric definitions, revision policy, and known limitations.
- A direct report link, access requirements, and a static summary with descriptive text.

Read the [dashboard methodology](methodology.qmd). An embedded report may be added when suitable for its audience, with a direct link available alongside it.
